pages.text: Refined Storage 2 offers several enhanced methods for moving items and fluids in and out of your storage network with improved efficiency and better reliability. The main components for this are:$(br2)$(l:importer)Importer$() - Moves items/fluids into your network with enhanced speed$(br)$(l:exporter)Exporter$() - Moves items/fluids out of your network with improved precision$(br)$(l:external)External Storage$() - Connects external inventories with better integration$(br)$(l:interface)Interface$() - Handles both automated insertion and extraction with enhanced capabilities$(br)$(l:constructor)Constructor$() - Places blocks and items with improved accuracy$(br)$(l:destructor)Destructor$() - Breaks blocks and collects items with better efficiency

Each component in RS2 features:$(li)Enhanced transfer rates$(li)Improved filtering capabilities$(li)Better mod compatibility$(li)Enhanced automation control$(li)Improved performance monitoring$(li)Better error handling$(br2)Use $(l:upgrades)Upgrades$() to further enhance their capabilities with improved efficiency.

For more specialized operations:$(br)$(br)• $(l:disk_manipulator)Disk Manipulator$() - Transfers items between storage disks and your network$(br)• $(l:reader)Reader$() - Monitors inventory contents and emits redstone signals$(br)• $(l:writer)Writer$() - Inserts or extracts items based on redstone signals$(br)$(br)Each of these components can be upgraded with various $(l:upgradesrs)Upgrades$() to enhance their functionality, speed, and filtering capabilities.
